local a = workspace.Phase1Map.town1
local out = {}
local rp = RaycastParams.new(); rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include; rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain}
for _, m in ipairs(a:GetDescendants()) do
  if m:IsA('Model') and m:GetAttribute('PlanKey') then
    local cf, sz = m:GetBoundingBox()
    local un, grey, n = 0, 0, 0
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA('BasePart') then n += 1; if not p.Anchored then un += 1 end; if p.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic then grey += 1 end end end
    local r = workspace:Raycast(cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 300, 0), Vector3.new(0, -600, 0), rp)
    table.insert(out, string.format('%s %s pos=(%.0f,%.1f,%.0f) size=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) parts=%d unanchored=%d plastic=%d bottom-ground=%.2f', m:GetAttribute('PlanKey'), m.Name, cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z, sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z, n, un, grey, (cf.Y - sz.Y/2) - (r and r.Position.Y or 0)))
  end
end
return table.concat(out, '\n')
